Pet Food Bank

The Humane Society of Charlotte provides free dog and cat food to Mecklenburg County residents facing challenges feeding their pets. The program offers temporary support for up to six months to help keep pets in their homes.

Charlotte, United StatesFree with eligibilityChecked 2026-08-14

Confirm before you go. Must live in Mecklenburg County, NC and own the pets. Standard assistance lasts up to 6 months. Appointments are required for pickup, and delivery options are available.
